extension.summary: Special event streams from iplayer. May break any time.
extension.description: Addon to play special events and red button streams from iplayer.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on is not developed by the BBC and is in no way affiliated with, or endorsed by the BBC.
extension.news: [B]v 2.2.0[/B] — Display current and future programmes in the description with the stream start time in the user's timezone. — Improved error handling and notifications. — Fix: UHD streams were played in HD when the stream was available in both resolutions.
